note: Written by the drift-race session after each recording session. The Arena reads this file to know which traces to load; it never guesses filenames. An empty `runs` array means no runs have been recorded yet, and the Arena says so rather than showing anything. Multiple passes of the same task+lane are separate entries distinguished by `pass`; exactly one per task+lane (per `tier`, where tiers are recorded) carries `promoted: true` and is the run the Arena replays. Other passes render as the run-to-run spread.
